title: Counting Escrow Deposits for Past-Due or Advanced Home Purchase Financing Escrow Accounts
content:
**Escrow administration practice note — the deposits counted in a Home Purchase Financing escrow projection**

**Terms used**

- *Days past due* are the calendar days from the oldest unpaid installment's due date to the analysis date, never below zero.
- *The home's current coverage term* is the 12 months that begin on the coverage start date of the newest premium paid from escrow to the borrower's own insurer, or on the funding date while no premium has yet been paid from escrow, its last day falling the day before the anniversary of that date.

**Rule.** Where the oldest unpaid installment is 30 or more days past due on the analysis date, the escrow deposits counted are the whole months from the oldest unpaid installment's due date to the last day of the home's current coverage term, plus one for the oldest unpaid installment itself. Where it is less than 30 days past due and the escrow balance is below zero, so that an advance is being recovered over the whole term, the escrow deposits counted are the whole months from the analysis date to that last day, plus one. In every other case the escrow deposits counted are not varied by this note.

| Condition on the analysis date | Escrow deposits counted |
|---|---|
| oldest unpaid installment 30 or more days past due | whole months from that installment's due date to the last day of the coverage term, plus one |
| fewer than 30 days past due, and escrow balance below zero | whole months from the analysis date to the last day of the coverage term, plus one |
| fewer than 30 days past due, escrow balance zero or above | not varied by this note |

### Worked counts (hypothetical loan; coverage term 2025-09-15 through 2026-09-14; analysis date 2026-01-05)

- *Oldest unpaid installment due 2025-11-15.* It is 51 days past due, so 30 or more. The whole months from 2025-11-15 to 2026-09-14 are 9 (the ninth ends 2026-08-15); plus one, 10 deposits are counted.
- *Oldest unpaid installment due 2026-01-01, escrow balance 120.00 below zero.* It is 4 days past due, under 30, with escrow below zero. The whole months from 2026-01-05 to 2026-09-14 are 8; plus one, 9 deposits are counted.
- *Boundary.* An installment exactly 30 days past due on the analysis date falls in the first row; 29 days past due does not.
